content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

apply_text_normalization.description: Whether to normalize text such as numbers and dates before generation.
apply_text_normalization.title: Apply Text Normalization

language_code.description: Language code (ISO 639-1) for speech generation and text normalization.
language_code.title: Language Code

output_format.description: Output format of the generated audio. Formatted as codec_sample_rate_bitrate.
output_format.title: Output Format

seed.description: Seed for best-effort reproducibility. Identical output is not guaranteed.
seed.title: Seed

similarity_boost.description: How closely the output follows the reference voice. Higher values increase similarity but may reduce naturalness.
similarity_boost.title: Similarity Boost

stability.description: Voice stability. Lower values allow more expressive delivery; higher values make delivery more consistent.
stability.title: Stability

text.description: The text to convert to speech. Supports audio tags such as [whispering] and IPA pronunciation enclosed in forward slashes.
text.title: Text

timestamps.description: Whether to return character-level timing information with the generated audio.
timestamps.title: Timestamps

voice.description: The voice to use for speech generation
voice.title: Voice

timestamps.description: Timestamps for each word in the generated speech. Only returned if `timestamps` is set to True in the request.
timestamps.title: Timestamps
